items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Josiah Gluck with me today.

ctx.x: Josiah was interviewed via Zoom on July 13, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Josiah Gluck with me today. And I’ve been reading about you so I know what you do but I’d like to afford you the opportunity to explain it yourself. Because it’s a bit complicated.

Well it’s kind of a unique straddling of both worlds in that I do music producing and engineering and I’ve had a lot of experience working in recording studios with different artists. But also I’ve spent thirty years at Saturday Night Live and I’m one of the two on- air music mixers for the show and I also handle post-production duties with other people where we take care of repeats, and I’m also sometimes mixing music videos that are produced for the show. So it encompasses a lot of audio production.
